description: This PHP source file defines a class 'VersionCheck' that performs version validation for the SecuritySuite module in SugarCRM. It checks if the security suite version matches the main SugarCRM version and displays a warning if there is a mismatch, including generating some dynamic HTML/JavaScript to alert the user.

classes.name: VersionCheck
classes.description: A class responsible for checking the version consistency of SecuritySuite plugin with SugarCRM and notifying administrators of mismatches.

methods.name: version_check
methods.description: Triggers a version check for SecuritySuite if the user is an admin and certain request parameters are not set; displays warning messaging if versions do not match.
